charts.title: fig5-combined
fig5-a-synthesis-rates
charts.srcdoc: Real — ATP and GTP synthesis flux from the FBA metabolism composite (build_mgen, interval=300 s, ~9 h). Fig 5A of Karr et al. 2012 shows all five carriers (ATP, GTP, NAD(H), FAD(H₂), NADP(H)); the reduced viva-Mgen model wires only ATP and GTP, so only those two are shown.

charts.title: fig5-b-ntp-vs-cellcycle
charts.srcdoc: Reduced / representative — Fig 5B of the paper is a 128-cell scatter of total NTP use vs cell-cycle length across a simulated population. This population is not modeled here; shown is the single-cell cumulative NTP (ATP+GTP) trajectory, whose endpoint is this cell's total NTP use at its cycle length. Labeled single-cell stand-in.

charts.title: fig5-c-atp-gtp-usage
charts.srcdoc: Real (carrier-level) stand-in — Fig 5C traces per-process ATP/GTP usage over the cycle. The reduced model exposes usage at the carrier level (ATP, GTP from metabolism), not per submodel; process-resolved allocation is summarized in panel (d), where translation dominates.

charts.title: fig5-d-energy-allocation
charts.srcdoc: Representative — of the MODELED expression energy, translation takes 96.8% and transcription 3.2% (measured by stepping the Transcription + Translation reproductions for 1 h and summing NTP/GTP consumed). Scaled into an accounted 56%, with a labeled 44% unaccounted slice echoing Fig 5D's structure (NAD/FAD/NADP + tRNA-aminoacylation + rest are not modeled). Ordering translation ≫ transcription is real.

charts.title: fig5-ratio-atp-gtp
charts.srcdoc: Real — mean ATP synthesis flux / mean GTP synthesis flux over the ~9 h metabolism run = 4.03×, close to the ≈4 ratio expected for the energy carriers.
